referencePolicy: Each generation used the listed repository images as actual referenced_image_paths inputs. Supplied visual references took precedence over the written style. No revisions or unreferenced illustrations were generated.

artworks.name: cover
artworks.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original illustration for the cover of the RANDOM tabletop roleplaying rulebook.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES, not images to reproduce: castle entry.jpg supplies architectural linework; young guy.jpg supplies energetic figure drafting; male driad.jpg supplies invented fantasy physiognomy; adventurer & monster.jpg supplies narrative depth and hatching. Match the actual visual references closely; the visual references take precedence over the written description wherever they differ. Do not copy any composition, character identity, signature, handwriting, watermark, or distinctive ornament.
Scene: an unlikely small company of three freely invented travelers pause at an ancient broken stone gateway and look out towards a distant winding path and a fantastical town. A wiry traveler in a practical patched cloak with a lantern, a short stocky companion carrying a bundle of miscellaneous gear, and a slender bark-featured wanderer. No uniforms, class labels, fixed lore, recognizable IP, or game mechanics. Evoke curiosity and open-ended adventure, not a battle poster.
Composition: landscape 3:2, intricate gateway and travelers arranged along the lower two thirds, open quiet pale paper in the upper third, distant architecture sketched lightly through the opening; varied human-scale silhouettes, diagonal depth, visually rich but airy. This is artwork only; typography will be laid out separately. Natural sketch edges dissolve into clean warm off-white paper on all sides, especially the upper edge. No rectangular frame or scene border.
Style/medium: Traditional hand-drawn fantasy illustration, reminiscent of an illustrator's pencil studies for a classic tabletop RPG rulebook. Graphite pencil and fine ink on warm, off-white paper. Predominantly monochromatic with natural graphite grays and subtle sepia tones. Loose, confident, expressive linework, visible construction lines, overlapping strokes, varied line weight, irregular contours, and organic imperfections. Detailed cross-hatching and directional pencil shading. Some areas carefully rendered while others remain deliberately unfinished. Authentic traditional sketchbook aesthetic, visibly handmade. No watercolor, painted color fills, digital gradients, airbrushing, photorealism, polished digital concept art, or 3D rendering.
No lettering, labels, numbers, signature, logos, or watermark. Keep the reference images' lively draftsmanship and unusual character of the lines; avoid generic smooth AI fantasy illustration.

artworks.name: characters
artworks.prompt:

Actual input images: female corsair for expressive facial and clothing lines, old dwarf for characterful age and gesture, male driad for inventive bark anatomy, draco warlock for exploratory portrait composition. These are visual STYLE references, never subjects to copy. The visual references take precedence over the written description wherever they differ.
Draw an original loose cluster of three half-length portrait studies on one sheet: a laughing older stocky traveler with weathered face and rolled sleeves, a thoughtful horned young woman with a simple scarf and travel-worn coat, and an alert slender bark-featured person with an asymmetrical cloak. Distinct personalities, believable expressive hands, layered practical clothing. The central portrait is slightly larger; the other two sit behind and to either side at different angles. No weapons catalog, class lineup, labels, annotations, costume uniforms, fixed lore, or identifiable copyrighted characters. One intimate sketchbook composition, not three bordered panels.

Predominantly monochromatic with natural graphite grays and subtle sepia tones. Loose, confident, expressive linework, visible construction lines, overlapping strokes, varied line weight, irregular contours, and organic imperfections. A quick-thinking traveler braces a round plain shield against an enormous invented many-legged insect creature while a companion pulls a hanging rope to drop a loose timber between them. The creature is a fantastical beetle-like silhouette, not a named species or recognizable IP. Emphasize teamwork and using the environment rather than class-specific combat powers. Keep two figures and one creature anatomically readable, avoid clutter. The scene dissolves at all edges into warm off-white paper, no enclosing rectangular frame. Landscape image with enough margin that every figure is fully visible.

Beside it are one engraving tool, a shallow dish with a few irregular mineral chips and a plain unlettered folded cloth. Magic is suggested only by tiny sketchy sparks around the blade, not glowing digital effects. No alphabet or diagram implying a fixed magic system. Detailed human hands, tangible nicked metal, expressive unfinished sketch contours.

artworks.name: camp
artworks.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original landscape 3:2 chapter illustration for Adventure in the RANDOM tabletop RPG rulebook.
Actual visual STYLE inputs: castle entry for irregular architectural ink contours, adventurer & monster for spatial depth and narrative linework, mage for clothing and organic hatching, old dwarf for expressive figures. The visual references take precedence over the written description wherever they differ. Use their artistic identity, never copy their composition, characters, handwriting or signatures.
Scene: a quiet traveling camp beneath the broken shelter of an old stone arch, seen at an intimate slightly elevated angle. Two original travel-worn companions sit near a very small campfire, one repairing a boot and the other unrolling a mostly blank map; a third stands a little farther back watching the open path. A simple slung canvas shelter, a kettle, a few packs and a lantern. Sparse low grasses and distant ruin silhouettes disappear into unfinished lines. Open-ended world, no emblems, established lore, class uniforms, captions, or magical restrictions. Human-scale, companionable, full of observed practical details. Fire shown with simple hand-drawn flickering strokes, not luminous rendered light. Keep the background airy and peripheral forms unfinished.
Traditional hand-drawn fantasy illustration, reminiscent of an illustrator's pencil studies for a classic tabletop RPG rulebook. Graphite pencil and fine ink on warm, off-white paper. Predominantly monochromatic with natural graphite grays and subtle sepia tones. Loose, confident, expressive linework, visible construction lines, overlapping strokes, varied line weight, irregular contours, and organic imperfections. Detailed cross-hatching and directional pencil shading. Some areas carefully rendered while others remain deliberately unfinished. Authentic traditional sketchbook aesthetic, visibly handmade. No watercolor, painted color fills, digital gradients, airbrushing, photorealism, polished digital concept art, or 3D rendering.
Allow the scene to dissolve naturally into clean warm off-white paper at all four edges. Detailed concentrated cross-hatching around packs, faces and stonework, lively exploratory lines elsewhere.
